title: Angle Stream Envelope
description: Envelope for every frame on Needle Guide's output-only inclination WebSocket (needle-guide SYSTEM_SPEC.md 5.3, electron/modules/inclinationStreamServer.ts). The wrapper is the one needle-guide's backend transport already uses (server/schemas/ws-envelope.json), narrowed to the fields this stream actually emits.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. `v` versions the WRAPPER, and the wrapper is unchanged when a new frame `type` or a new payload field is added -- that is exactly what happened when the heartbeat gained protocol_version. A subscriber that rejects unknown envelope fields would break on an additive change that is deliberately NOT a version bump, so this schema is liberal in what it accepts and strict only about what must be present.

v.description: Envelope version. Deliberately NOT bumped by adding a frame type: `type` is what selects the payload.

type.description: Selects the payload. `inclination` is canonical; `theta` is the deprecated dual-emit copy; `heartbeat` carries liveness only.

ts.description: Host wall-clock ISO-8601 stamp taken when the frame was built. The two angle frames describing one sample carry the SAME ts.
